documents.title: Washington County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 157 pages. Amounts are the "2026 Budget REQUESTED" (summary, pp. 5-6) / "2026 Requested" (department pages); the ordinance adopts this budget in full (Article 3) and no other 2026 column is printed column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
